repositories.supported_mechanism: Durable dispatch markers, conservative recovery and replay suppression.
repositories.limitation: Local fixture adapters; injected exceptions, not a measured power-loss or distributed exactly-once guarantee.
repositories.proposed_next_eval: Exercise a real subprocess interruption and reconcile an adapter outcome without blindly retrying.

repositories.supported_mechanism: Deterministic lexical retrieval, citation binding, abstention and adversarial fixtures.
repositories.limitation: No embeddings, reranker or live LLM; fixture scores do not estimate real-world answer accuracy.
repositories.proposed_next_eval: Add held-out queries with irrelevant-but-valid citations and report precision separately from source binding.

repositories.supported_mechanism: Tool scope, expiry and atomic usage reservation with explicit denial and outcome audit.
repositories.limitation: Trusted in-process callers; not an authenticated network service, MCP server or OS sandbox.
repositories.proposed_next_eval: Add an authenticated broker boundary and verify expiry, revocation and concurrent budget consumption there.

repositories.supported_mechanism: DAG validation, bounded concurrency, explicit safe retries, cancellation and journal recovery.
repositories.limitation: Single scheduler/journal; adapters must cooperate with cancellation; no distributed scheduling or universal power-loss guarantee.
repositories.proposed_next_eval: Inject journal-write failures during concurrent execution and check worker joining and persisted/in-memory state agreement.

repositories.supported_mechanism: Payload-bound idempotency, atomic debit/credit/outbox and exclusive job claims.
repositories.limitation: Single-host SQLite; the demonstration sink shares the transaction. No external-sink exactly-once, tenant auth or accounting certification.
repositories.proposed_next_eval: Move the sink outside the transaction and test lost acknowledgement, deduplication retention and reconciliation.

repositories.supported_mechanism: Sequence-numbered state feed, cursor replay, snapshot fallback and slow-consumer eviction.
repositories.limitation: Loopback TCP JSON-lines, not WebSockets; state is not durable across restart and transport buffering is outside the application queue bound.
repositories.proposed_next_eval: Add restart persistence and an explicit total-connection limit; measure slow-consumer behavior end to end.

repositories.supported_mechanism: Local routing-security tests for allowlists, replay domains, slippage, reentrancy and invariants.
repositories.limitation: Native-asset fixture, not a deployed multichain bridge or independent security audit. The allowlist owner remains trusted.
repositories.proposed_next_eval: Extend adversarial adapter cases and obtain an independent review before any deployment claim.

repositories.supported_mechanism: Responsive session journal with persisted settings, interaction tests, axe checks and an asset-size budget.
repositories.limitation: Synthetic local data; exercised Chromium/axe checks are not complete accessibility certification, broad browser coverage or live financial integration.
repositories.proposed_next_eval: Add manual keyboard/screen-reader review and a second browser engine; measure field performance separately from bundle size.
